content.value: Etching removes surface defects and relieves surface residual stress. A 5 mm thick boro- (10) silicate glass after etching has cracks inside ranging from 2 to 5 μm in length. Calculate the surface energy of glass using following parameters: Fracture strength is 90 MPa, Young's Modulus is 60 GPa and Poison's ratio is 0.3.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
